verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a built-in "Gemini AI assistant in Gmail", and the Workspace updates blog mentions Google Meet's "Take notes for me" feature, a concrete task users can hand off to built-in AI. Both are single-line mentions with no detail on what tasks can be delegated, how, or how far the assistant reaches across Docs, Sheets, Drive and other apps. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's task-delegation capabilities, coverage across Workspace apps beyond Gmail and Meet, any multi-step or agentic task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
